authority: A17 and direct instruction to register the limited intended Dutch paper claims. No systematic testing suite.
review_when: Any change to parent cells, years, estimand, wording, claim family or uncertainty must re-run Q08 before use in paper.
limitations: This register is made after results exist; it is not confirmatory preregistration.
Formal tests limited to three PISA long-term mean changes, with Holm adjustment across those three.
IEA long-term changes are descriptive; the conditional sampling/PV intervals exclude unquantified long-period linking error.
SES gaps use joint within-cycle covariance and are conditional on chosen SES measurement/calibration.
Sample nonresponse, exclusions, mode and omitted uncertainty cannot be repaired by small p-values.

evidence.locator: Table of linking errors for mean comparisons between PISA 2025 and earlier cycles; table index 3 in retained parser output
Chapter 13: Estimating standard errors for comparing independent/dependent results
Chapter 13, pp.13.7-13.8: independent/dependent samples and omitted trend linking error

claims.claim_text: Describe the Dutch PIRLS reading mean change between 2001 and 2021.
claims.quality_note: Repeated cross-sections; no individual cohort or causal claim. Country-cycle response and mode qualifications from Q02 apply. IEA does not supply a total long-period linking-error variance here; descriptive change and sampling/PV interval only, no formal significance claim.

claims.claim_text: Describe the Dutch PIRLS reading Q4-minus-Q1 mean gap in 2021.
claims.quality_note: Conditional on the chosen SES construction; books and Cobreros measures are different constructs. No between-age or causal contrast.
